newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 14.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Japan's gross domestic product (GDP) rose an annualised 3.9 percent in the October-December period.
-- Recruitment of college graduates will rise 15.8 percent in the business year starting April 1998 from the year earlier period.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto sees zero growth in government's general account budget.
-- Leak of radiation at the Tokaimura nuclear reprocessing plant went undetected for five hours.
-- Japan's securities watchdog, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC), suspects money changed hands in Nomura Securities incident.
